name: @epoch/test-harness
description: Epoch Cross-domain Integration Harness (W032) — a typed, deterministic SCENARIO ENGINE generalizing the W031 reference-slice pattern: declarative, content-addressed scenario definitions (actors, fixtures, a typed step sequence, expected invariants); a runner that composes REAL workspace kernels through a caller-supplied ScenarioDriver (the harness never mocks Epoch kernels and never imports kernel internals — the composed kernels arrive as devDependencies of the TEST trees, never as runtime dependencies of this library) and records a sealed, replayable, byte-deterministic typed execution TRACE per step (input digest, output digest, events emitted, provenance, identity observations, state-digest delta); a reusable invariant library (tenant isolation at every boundary, provenance chain verification, authority routing, identity preservation across projections, replay determinism, round-trip); and a typed, content-addressed RESULT record per scenario (pass/fail per invariant + the trace digest). Zero wall-clock, zero randomness, zero network.
